intent: Forks, execs, and manages one bedrock server subprocess for tests, and provides the request/response plumbing and direct DB access tests use against it.

objects.name: BedrockTester
objects.role: owns one bedrock server subprocess: starts/stops it, sends it commands over TCP, reads its DB file directly, and tracks all live instances for stopAll

objects.name: BedrockTester::autoAttachDebugger
objects.role: speaks a small JSON-over-socket protocol to an LLDB RPC server to auto-attach a debugger to the spawned process

misfits.why: A self-contained LLDB RPC-socket client with its own wire protocol, unrelated to running a server subprocess and sending it commands
misfits.suggested_home: a standalone debug-attach helper, or null

location_fit.note: Fits; core per-server test harness class.

naming_quality.note: Repo-typical (_-prefixed private members); _commitCountBase vs. the reference member _commitCount is a little confusing on first read but is explained at the constructor.
